summary: This directory provides structural analysis logic for TypeScript destructuring patterns. It identifies and extracts binding elements, nested patterns, default values, and associated dependencies or reserved names from array and object binding constructs.
responsibilities: Decompose array and object binding patterns into constituent elements.
Identify local identifiers and default values within destructuring assignments.
Aggregate metadata and dependencies related to binding structures.
Dispatch analysis logic based on the specific type of binding name encountered.
relationships: The binding name analyzer acts as a dispatcher to select the correct logic for either array or object binding patterns.
Binding elements are recursively analyzed to capture nested patterns or identifiers present within complex destructuring assignments.
designDecisions: Uses a dispatcher pattern to handle varying types of binding constructs.
Functional decomposition of analysis logic based on the specific syntax node being processed.
